subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this seven-table, environment-gated durable runtime and its public CLI, Gateway, protocol, and agent-delivery surfaces as the supported beta foundation?
rationale: The patch is not only an implementation repair: it establishes a new persistent data model, operator configuration, public protocol, and cross-owner runtime semantics whose permanent ownership and rollout require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor after exact-head proof
options.body: Adopt the full durable-core beta contract after the iOS failure is resolved and inspectable upgrade, restart, close/reopen, delivery, and rollback proof is complete.

options.title: Narrow to internal primitives
options.body: Land only the shared-state and generic runtime primitives first while deferring public CLI, Gateway, protocol, and agent delivery surfaces.

options.title: Pause the durable stack
options.body: Do not merge this stack until a maintainer owns the persistent model, product scope, and rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Adopt the full durable-core beta contract after the iOS failure is resolved and inspectable upgrade, restart, close/reopen, delivery, and rollback proof is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available merged-history and architecture signal across the Gateway and agent lifecycle surfaces that must own this cross-cutting product decision.
